maria: Heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to clarify the bootstrap step for semi-airgapped/private installs. Focus: minimal UX wording, a tiny conn-check script, and KMS/HSM env examples. Will link to the migration guide. @jamie @sachin please review networking/KMS bits.

jamie: sgtm. Can you split the PR into two commits? 1) wording + link fixes, 2) code snippets/examples. Easier to revert/patch. Also ping devex for the button text change. :+1:

sachin: For KMS/HSM section: explicitly call out PKCS#11 default paths and the env var names we set in the installer (REDWOOD_PKCS11_LIB, REDWOOD_HSM_SLOT). Also the port table needs both 5696 and 5697 (HSM admin) included — folks have been assuming 443 only which breaks fw rules.

maria: Yep — I added a short checklist in the PR description: how to smoke-test in a VM, what links to update, and a test-plan to verify ACLs. Pasted the conn-check snippet below (will move to /examples/semiairgap/conn-check.sh once folks sign off):

```bash
# conn-check.sh - quick connectivity checks for semi-airgapped installs
set -e
# metadata fallback check (may be blocked in sealed sites)
curl -sSf --connect-timeout 5 http://169.254.169.254 || echo "metadata unreachable"
# simple KMS/HSM port checks
if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  nc -zv kms.local 5696 || echo "KMS API port 5696 unreachable"
  nc -zv hsm.local 5697 || echo "HSM admin port 5697 unreachable"
else
  curl -sSf --connect-timeout 5 http://kms.local:5696/health || echo "kms health endpoint failed"
fi
```

maria: Also added a short note re: systemd override needed on some RHEL variants (example): `systemctl edit redwood-installer.service` add `Environment=REDWOOD_PKCS11_LIB=/usr/lib64/libpkcs11.so`.

jamie: Perfect. Can you also add a sentence under "Known limitations" about MTU/path MTU causing long handshake timeouts? We've seen installs fail on VXLAN with default 1500.

maria: Done — added an example `ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1400` and a short rationale. I also replaced an outdated link to the migration checklist (old page) with the new URL.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4312 — label: docs, semiairgap, needs-review

sachin: I'll review the KMS/HSM bits by EOD. If the PKCS11 paths look correct I'll add a quick note about SELinux boolean troubleshooting.

ops-ash: tagging ops for staging smoke: once PR merged, can you kick the small staging job? I have a VM with a sealed network to run the checklist.

maria: thanks — assigning reviewers in the PR and moving the script to examples/semiairgap after muster. If anyone wants wording tweaks, leave inline comments; aim to merge tomorrow AM. :rocket:

jamie: thanks all — small, focused PRs make backports easier. :thumbsup:
